page.overview:
What is Captain of the King's Ships?

Captain of the King's Ships was the title given to the chief captain of the King's Ships in Númenor.

The title was especially associated with the great navigator Vëantur, the first Númenórean to make the sea-voyage back to Middle-earth, on his flagship Entulessë. The importance of Vëantur’s office is made clear in that his daughter Almarian was taken in marriage by the King’s Heir, Tar-Meneldur, and so went on to become a Queen of Númenor. Meneldur and Almarian had a son, Aldarion, who inherited his grandfather’s love of the sea. Aldarion became known as the Great Captain, and founded the Guild of Venturers in Númenor.
